title: FHIR R4 Implementation Guide (mCODE-aligned profiles + value sets)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Hee-Lee Oss never holds patient data. A FHIR R4 Implementation Guide with mCODE-aligned profiles and value sets makes the standard implementable; IG license is CC0/CC-BY per PLAN section 16 Q3 (depends on cde-020, terminology-021). Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Build a FHIR R4 Implementation Guide with mCODE-aligned profiles and value sets that passes the HL7 IG Publisher/validator in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: IG builds and passes the HL7 FHIR IG Publisher/validator in CI
